# T Krobot sticker working copies

Downscaled (max 900px) working copies of the locked v11 sticker pack, vendored for the banner compositor (`scripts/banner/`).

**Canonical source: [tinkertanker/tkrobot-stickers](https://github.com/tinkertanker/tkrobot-stickers)** — `stickers/` + `manifest.json`. Do not edit these PNGs here; re-copy from the source repo to update, and read that repo AGENTS.md before generating new poses.

| Pose | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `greetings` | Friendly wave / hello. |
| `point-left` | Pointing left; mirrored pair of point-right. |
| `point-right` | Pointing right. |
| `thumbsup` | Thumbs-up approval. |
| `handraise` | Raised hand as if volunteering or asking a question. |
| `salute` | Salute with both arms present. |
| `fingerguns` | Playful finger-guns gesture. |
| `jumping-for-joy` | Jumping celebration with happy eyes. |
| `ok` | OK / acknowledgement hand sign. |
| `running-right` | Running right / on-my-way energy. |
| `heart` | Holding or presenting a heart. |
| `yay` | Upright celebration with raised arms. |

Palette sampled from the pack: red `#FB0101`, emanata orange `#FCA403`, limb grey `#E1E1E1`, ink `#141414`.
